blockingFindings.issue: The staged narrative is substantially non-circular, but the register still leaves downstream admission ambiguous. MC04 also retains an unqualified MC01 dependency, while MC01-EXTENSIONS includes work owned by downstream MC05–MC07; only I2/F2 explicitly receive the atomic prerequisite exception.
